independent-checks.quote: INFO511 NHANES wrangling-v1. Selected public CDC August 2021–August 2023 data; two synthetic learners. This purposive subset supports data engineering only, not population or medical conclusions.

explanation-reproducibility.quote: Each tidy row represents one selected participant and systolic reading. A DEMO-anchored one-to-one join preserves participants without a BPXO record. The status describes file membership, not why a measurement is absent. Melting retains three rows per participant and every missing position. Key checks, per-reading missing counts, scalar comparisons and a pivot roundtrip independently verify values. Both input frames remain unchanged. This purposive public subset supports no population, causal or medical conclusion.
